description.value: Second Cup is Canada's largest specialty coffee chain, founded in 1975, offering lattes, espressos, cold brew, tea, hot chocolates, smoothies, baked goods, and breakfast items. The Christina Lake location sits on McGregor Frontage Road and is a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the southern Okanagan corridor. Online ordering is available and takeout is confirmed.

address.value: 1590 McGregor Frontage Rd, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Second Cup location page at secondcup.com/en/location/christina-lake/ confirms this is a real, operating café at 1590 McGregor Frontage Rd, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E0. The OSM tag takeaway=yes and the website's 'Order Online' button both confirm takeout service. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address sourced from website location page (1590 McGregor Frontage Rd, Christina Lake, BC V0H 1E0).
OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 06:00-21:00) differ slightly from website hours (6:00 am – 9:00 pm daily); website is preferred.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible café confirmed by the brand's own location page. A useful stop for touring cyclists on the Christina Lake corridor.
